facts.claim: In-house thermodynamic engineering and R&D design team conducting CFD cooling simulations and pressure-pulse testing.
Air-oil heat exchangers (scambiatori aria-olio / radiatori) with 12V/24V DC, 230V/400V AC, and hydraulic motor fan drives.
Water-oil shell and tube heat exchangers (scambiatori a fascio tubiero acqua-olio serie MG).
Combi-Coolers: Combined cooling modules integrating hydraulic oil, transmission oil, diesel fuel, and charge air (CAC).
Brazed and gasketed plate heat exchangers for industrial cooling and refrigeration circuits.
Quality management system certified according to UNI EN ISO 9001:2015.
Certified compliance with Pressure Equipment Directive (PED 2014/68/EU) and ASME standards for pressure vessels.
ATEX certified cooling units for hazardous environments and explosive atmospheres.
Main plant and global headquarters: Via Newton 52, 20062 Cassano d'Adda (Milano), covering modern production and test laboratories.
International sales and assembly subsidiaries: Emmegi GmbH (Germany), Emmegi Inc. (USA), Emmegi Ltd (UK), and Emmegi s.r.o. (Slovakia).
Member of Federtec (Italian Association of Fluid Power and Power Transmission Equipment).
Regular exhibitor at major industrial machinery and fluid power fairs: Bauma, Agritechnica, EIMA, and Hannover Messe.
Official digital web domains: emmegi-heat-exchangers.com and emmegi.group.
Web server stack running Apache and PHP with online thermodynamic cooler sizing and calculation software.
Extensive technical documentation published online with heat dissipation curves, dimensional CAD drawings, and installation guides.
